affected_boundaries: test proof factory and exact execution-evidence reader

observed_behavior: The accepted publication scenario failed when renewed QA evidence contained endedAt in addition to the canonical fields.
expected_behavior: The proof factory creates only the defined startedAt and completedAt timestamp fields, and invalid literal properties fail compilation.
causal_mechanism: The map callback inferred a wider evidence object. Structural assignability allowed its extra endedAt property through the submission argument, while the exact runtime reader correctly rejected it.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A valid test-data factory infers its return shape instead of constructing the declared contract.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: Additional properties in a structurally assignable inferred value evade contextual literal checking.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Valid proof factories return the declared RollingSubmissionProof shape.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Use completedAt, annotate the map callback return as RollingSubmissionProof, and type the enclosing submission. Preserve exact runtime validation.

applicability_conditions: A valid fixture map callback constructs contract literals without an explicit return type.
known_non_matches: Explicitly malformed values used to test a rejecting reader remain unknown inputs.
confirmation_evidence: The fixture compilation succeeded but the exact evidence reader rejected endedAt; the accepted publication test failed at recordIncrementProof.
